definitions.explanation: Something that was not anticipated or predicted; outside of what was expected.

examples.japanese: {予想外|よそうがい}の{結果|けっか}だった。
{予想外|よそうがい}に{早|はや}く{終|お}わった。
{予想外|よそうがい}の{展開|てんかい}に{驚|おどろ}いた。
examples.english: I was surprised by the unexpected development.

notes:
COMPOUND: {予想|よそう} (expectation) + {外|がい} (outside)

USAGE PATTERNS:
- {予想外|よそうがい}の + Noun (unexpected ~)
- {予想外|よそうがい}に (unexpectedly)
- {予想外|よそうがい}だ (it's unexpected)

SIMILAR EXPRESSIONS:
- {意外|いがい} (unexpected, surprising)
- {思|おも}いがけない (unexpected)
- {予期|よき}せぬ (unforeseen)

CAN BE POSITIVE OR NEGATIVE: {予想外|よそうがい} simply indicates deviation from expectations, regardless of whether the outcome is good or bad.
